name: s16_list_databases
description: List all databases in the workspace. Returns only id, name, icon, description. Use s16_get_database to get properties.

name: s16_get_database
description: Get a database schema: properties (id, name, type, isPrimary), views, and templates (id, name, isDefault). Use property IDs for filters/sorts in s16_list_pages. Use template IDs with s16_get_template/s16_apply_template.

name: s16_get_public_database
description: Get a database schema through a public share link. Useful for parity with shared page/doc UI flows.

shareId.description: Public share ID from a shared page or doc

name: s16_create_database
description: Create a new database in the workspace. Automatically creates the primary title property and the default table view.

parentPageId.description: Optional parent page ID for embedded databases

isPrivate.description: Whether the database is private to its creator

name: s16_update_database
description: Update database metadata such as name, icon, description, property order, and privacy.

name: s16_reorder_databases
description: Reorder top-level databases in the workspace sidebar/workspace view.

name: s16_set_database_default_template
description: Set or clear the default template for new pages in a database.

templateId.description: Template page ID or null to clear

name: s16_delete_database
description: Delete a database. Requires admin or owner access.

name: s16_create_property
description: Create a new property/column in a database. For relation properties, set config.relatedDatabaseId (required) and config.twoWay (default: true) to auto-create an inverse column on the target DB.

config.description: Property config. For relations: { relatedDatabaseId, twoWay?, inverseName? }

name: s16_update_property
description: Update a database property: rename, change config flags (sensitive, wrapContent, displayAs), update select/multi_select options, or replace the formula expression of a formula-typed property. Config flags are merged with existing config (not replaced).

limit.description: Selection limit for relation or multi_select. null removes the limit.

color.description: Option color: blue, green, yellow, red, purple, gray

formula.description: Formula expression for formula-typed properties (e.g. `dateBetween(now(), prop("Created time"), "workdays")`). Only applies when property.type === "formula".

name: s16_delete_property
description: Delete a property/column from a database.

name: s16_duplicate_property
description: Duplicate an existing property/column.

name: s16_rename_property_option
description: Rename a select, multi_select, or status option and propagate the change into stored cell values.

name: s16_delete_property_option
description: Delete a select, multi_select, or status option and remove its usages from existing rows.

name: s16_list_pages
description: List pages/rows in a database. Returns propertiesCache (may be stale/incomplete). Use withCells to load fresh values for specific properties from DB. Supports search, filters (ANDed), sort, field projection. Filter operators: contains/not_contains/equals/not_equals/gt/lt/gte/lte/is_empty/is_not_empty/is_checked/is_not_checked/before/after.

search.description: Full-text search across all cell values

searchField.description: Restrict search to this property ID

fields.description: Return only these property IDs from propertiesCache (primary always included)

withCells.description: Load fresh cell values from DB for these property IDs

name: s16_list_public_pages
description: List rows in a publicly shared database context using a share ID.

search.description: Full-text search across all cell values

searchField.description: Restrict search to this property ID

name: s16_count_pages
description: Count rows in a database with optional filters and search.

name: s16_count_public_pages
description: Count rows in a publicly shared database context using a share ID.

name: s16_get_page
description: Get a page/row with all its cell values

name: s16_get_public_page
description: Get a public page through its share ID.

name: s16_create_page
description: Create a new page/row in a database. Can set title, all property values, and rich content in one call. For cells, use property NAME (case-insensitive) as key. Value types: text/title/url/email/phone→string, number→number, checkbox→boolean, date→ISO string, select/status→option label string, multi_select→comma-separated labels or string[], relation→comma-separated target page UUIDs or string[] of UUIDs.

cells.description: Property values as { propertyName: value }. Use property NAME (case-insensitive). For relation: pass string[] of UUIDs. Example: { "Status": "Active", "Company": ["uuid1", "uuid2"] }

content.description:
Page body content in markdown or HTML. For images/files/charts use HTML:
or
(requires contentFormat: "html"). Full spec: s16_guide({ category: "agents", sections: ["richEmbeds"] }).

contentFormat.description: Content format. MUST be "html" when content includes <div data-type="file-embed"> or <div data-type="chart-embed"> — markdown mode strips them.

name: s16_archive_page
description: Archive a page/row.

name: s16_delete_page
description: Move a page/row to trash (soft delete). Can be restored later via s16_restore_page.

name: s16_bulk_delete_pages
description: Move multiple pages/rows to trash (soft delete). Can be restored later.

name: s16_duplicate_page
description: Duplicate a page/row including its values and page settings.

name: s16_set_page_sharing
description: Enable or disable public sharing for a page.

isPublic.description: Whether the page should be public

name: s16_update_cell
description: Update a single cell value on a page. Use property ID (UUID). Value types by property type: text/title/url/email/phone→string, number→number, checkbox→boolean, date→ISO string, select/status→option label string, multi_select→comma-separated labels, relation→comma-separated target page UUIDs or string[] of UUIDs, files→array of { name, url, size?, mimeType? } objects (use s16_upload_file first to get URLs). Prefer s16_bulk_update_cells to update multiple fields at once.

name: s16_bulk_update_cells
description: Update multiple cell values on a page in one call. Use property NAME (case-insensitive) as key. Value types: text/title/url/email/phone→string, number→number, checkbox→boolean, date→ISO string, select/status→option label string, multi_select→comma-separated labels or string[], relation→comma-separated target page UUIDs or string[] of UUIDs, files→array of { name, url, size?, mimeType? } objects.

databaseId.description: Database ID (needed to resolve property names)

cells.description: Property values as { propertyName: value }. Use property NAME (case-insensitive).

name: s16_update_page
description: Update an existing page/row: set cell values and/or replace page content. Use property NAME (case-insensitive) for cells. Content can be markdown (default) or HTML.

databaseId.description: Database ID (needed to resolve property names)

content.description:
Page body content in markdown or HTML (replaces existing). For images/files/charts use HTML:
or
. Full spec: s16_guide({ category: "agents", sections: ["richEmbeds"] }).

contentFormat.description: Content format. MUST be "html" when content includes <div data-type="file-embed"> or <div data-type="chart-embed"> — markdown mode strips them.

config.description: Page config merge patch, e.g. { fullWidth: true }

name: s16_get_page_content
description: Get the rich content (HTML) of a page/row. Returns the full HTML body of the page editor.

name: s16_update_page_content
description:
Set the rich content of a page/row. Accepts markdown (converted to HTML) or raw HTML. Replaces all existing content. Supported markdown syntax: - Headings: # H1, ## H2, ### H3 - Bold: **text**, Italic: *text*, Strikethrough: ~~text~~ - Inline code: `code`, Links: [text](url) - Bullet list: - item - Numbered list: 1. item - Task list (to-do): - [ ] unchecked, - [x] checked - Blockquote: > text - Code block: ```lang ... ``` - Horizontal rule: --- - Collapsible block (toggle): >>> Title\ncontent lines\n<<< (use ">>> closed: Title" to start collapsed) For IMAGES / FILES / CHARTS use contentFormat: "html" and emit: -
— renders as image if mimetype starts with image/, otherwise as a download card. Get url via s16_upload_file. -
— Chart.js config in data-config (escape quotes as "). Types: bar, line, pie, doughnut, radar, polarArea, scatter, bubble. Full attribute reference + gotchas: s16_guide({ category: "agents", sections: ["richEmbeds"] }).

content.description: Content in markdown or HTML format. Use HTML for images/files/charts (see tool description).

contentFormat.description: Content format: "markdown" (default) or "html". MUST be "html" when content includes <div data-type="file-embed"> or <div data-type="chart-embed">.

name: s16_list_doc_children

name: s16_get_doc_backlinks

name: s16_list_trash_docs

Categories: "agents" (execution modes, data model CRUD, tools, sandbox API, rich embeds in page content, model selection), "page_templates" (content structure, styles, config, embeds, variables, MCP workflow). Call without sections to get the full guide for a category. Use sections=["richEmbeds"] to look up how to embed images, files, or Chart.js charts inside page HTML content.

sections.description: Limit to specific sections. Agents: overview, execution, dataModel, legacyTools, sandboxApi, richEmbeds, mcpTools, modelSelection. Page templates: overview, content, styles, config, embeds, variables, mcpTools

icon.description: Emoji icon for pages created from this template

content.description:
Content object: { html: "

Hello

" }. Use semantic HTML only (p, h1-h3, ul, ol, table, blockquote). No div layouts. Embed databases via

embeds.description:
Embedded databases: [{ id: "unique-id", databaseId: "uuid", viewType: "table"|"board"|"list"|"gallery", filters: [{propertyId, operator, value}], sorts: [{propertyId, direction}] }]. Reference in HTML via
. Filter values support {{variables}}.

name: s16_get_agent

category.description: Optional category. Pass null to clear.

compiledScript.description: Manually set the compiled JS script. Pass null to clear.

timeout.description: Execution timeout in seconds (default 3600 = 1 hour, max 86400 = 24 hours)

name: s16_delete_agent
description: Delete an AI agent

name: s16_set_trigger
description: Create an agent trigger. Types: event (DB changes), cron (scheduled), webhook (HTTP endpoint), gmail (polls for new emails), agent_change (fires when ANOTHER agent is edited). Webhook triggers generate a unique URL. Gmail triggers require a Google OAuth credential with email capability. The agent_change trigger lets one agent react to edits on a target agent — useful for audit/notify/sync workflows.

config.description: Trigger config. Event: { database_id, event: "row.created"|"row.updated"|"row.deleted", condition?: { property_id?, page_id?, old_value?, new_value?, old_value_includes?, new_value_includes? } }. To trigger on a specific column value change, use event: "row.updated" with condition.property_id + condition.new_value (or new_value_includes). Do NOT use "property.changed" — it is accepted by the API but does not fire in practice. Cron: { expression: string, timezone?: string, inputPrompt?: string (≤8KB, optional default prompt), inputData?: object (≤64KB JSON, optional default params merged into context.inputData at fire time — use this for multi-tenant scheduled agents: one engine, N crons, each carrying its own params; do NOT put secrets here, store them via s16.setSecret and reference by key) }. Webhook: {} (no config needed). Gmail: { credential_title?: string, label_ids?: ["INBOX"], query?: string, poll_interval_seconds?: number (default 120, min 30) }. agent_change: { agentId: <UUID of the agent to watch>, fields?: string[] (optional whitelist — only fire if at least one of these changed; valid keys: name, category, description, systemPrompt, model, modelParams, tools, inputSchema, skillIds, timeout, compiledScript, isLocked, accessLevel, status), excludeSources?: ("app"|"mcp"|"restore"|"system")[] (skip events from these sources to avoid loops). The agent listens to changes on the TARGET agent and runs with triggerContext = { agentId, userId, source, changedFields }. Self-loop is auto-prevented (an agent never triggers itself).

webhookMode.description: Webhook only: async (200 OK immediately) or sync (waits for script, returns s16.respond() result). Default: async

name: s16_delete_trigger
description: Delete an agent trigger

name: s16_run_agent
description: Run an agent manually. Returns a run object with id/status. Use s16_await_run to wait for completion and get output/logs. Compiled agents execute their JS script; uncompiled agents use LLM tool-calling loop.

name: s16_run_agent_by_name
description: Find an agent by name (case-insensitive substring match) and run it. Useful when you know the agent name but not its UUID. Returns the run object.

name.description: Agent name or substring to match (e.g. "Buffer", "Transcript Importer")

await.description: If true, wait for the run to complete (up to 120s) and return full result including logs and output. Default: false

name: s16_await_run
description: Wait for an agent run to complete (polls every 1s, up to 120s). Returns full run details including output, logs, and token usage.

runId.description: Agent run ID to wait for

name: s16_cancel_run
description: Cancel a running agent run. Terminates the worker thread and updates run status to "cancelled". Safe to call on already-finished runs (no-op).

name: s16_compile_agent
description: Compile an agent into a sandboxed JS script via AI. Alternative: write the script yourself via s16_update_agent({ compiledScript }). The compiled script runs in node:vm with s16.* API (s16.db.listRows, s16.db.updateCell, s16.ai, s16.http, s16.store.*, etc.) and context object. Saves ~95% tokens vs legacy LLM mode. Use s16_guide({ category: "agents", sections: ["sandboxApi"] }) for API reference.
